definition: A service-management problem that has been analyzed and for which a cause or workaround is recorded.
rationale: Use this noun phrase for an analyzed service-management problem with a recorded cause or workaround. Keep it distinct from an unresolved problem, an incident, and the workaround itself; recording a known error does not perform the root-cause fix.

allowed.text: The known error links the recurring timeout to the database configuration.
allowed.rationale: Names an analyzed problem and its recorded cause.

not_allowed.text: The known error removed the database fault.
not_allowed.rationale: A known-error record does not itself remove the underlying cause.

locator.section: What skills will you acquire? / Problem management
